items.name: Sim in Qual
items.quick: Learning about qualatative data, in the style of a TV quiz show
items.desc: A year one introduction to qualitative data and statistics. Inspired by the quiz show “Bullseye”, two teams or individuals choose numbers on a target (throwing a foam ball or touching a segment) and have to answer the multiple choice questions. After 4 and 8 segment rounds, in the third round they are given a quote and have to put it into one of three categories. The person with the highest score of the three rounds then has to decide whether or not to gamble everyone’s RISE points on a final question to score 4 times the total of points. If they fail they are shown what they could have won (a speedboat) but no one goes home empty handed – 20 RISE points for everyone! Requires someone to be the quiz host to move the experience along. This format could easily be adapted for quizzes on other subjects.
items.system: Intuiface
obj: Reinforce their knowledge of qualitative feedback analysis

items.name: Sim in Quant
items.quick: Learning about quantitive data, in the style of a TV quiz show
items.desc: A year 3 quiz about quantitive statistical analysis, in the style of several game shows. Quant Phrase – Guess the statistical term represented by the cartoon. Play Your Quants Right – Will the answer to each question be higher or lower? The Perfect Line – Be the first to put the experimental steps in the correct order. Non-Familial Fortunes – Put the five survey answers in descending order of popularity. The four games are linked by a background story of playing against a super quiz computer. This format could easily be adapted for quizzes on other subjects.
items.system: Intuiface
obj: Reinforce their knowledge of quantitive statistical analysis.

Hold the power button on the left side for a few seconds. It fits over glasses. Slide the lenses side to side until the view is sharp, then tighten the straps for a snug fit. Volume controls are on the underside, front left.
You need the controllers. Click the time at the bottom of the menu to open settings, choose boundary → stationary, then switch to room scale. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Always use the wrist straps. The index-finger trigger is the main select button, like a mouse click. The Oculus button on the right controller returns you to the home screen — use it if someone gets stuck in an app.
Hold the power button until the shutdown menu appears, then select Power Off. Or hold the power button for 10 seconds to shut down without the controllers.
